Overview

Köniz is a city in Bern with a population of 42,000. A suburban municipality near Bern with a mix of urban and rural living, known for its castle, the Gurten mountain, and excellent schools. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
